text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Phew... What could it be, my legs feel so heavy.
Is it lingering fatigue from the race...?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
—...gh, no...
At times like this, stretching is essential
to relieve the fatigue in my legs...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...... If I can just
overcome this, I'm sure......

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Messiah doesn't seem to have recovered well
from the fatigue of the race.
It will be necessary to reconsider her upcoming race schedule.
